quest.title: Snowy Silhouette: Hope
quest.description: According to Joel, Cyrus has found some leads as to his father's whereabouts...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Will I really find Dad this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any news about your father?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Pallad told me that Uncle Cyrus might have found some news about my dad.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: He can't be sure yet, but according to Pallad, their latest leads seem pretty promising, so they might just find him.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: I'd love to go up Dragonspine with them, but Uncle Cyrus says that I should stay in the camp, and that they'll tell me once they get more news...

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Could you help me look for Uncle Cyrus and ask him, please?

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: I... I'm afraid that the news... might be bad...

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: Either way... I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: In this area, huh... Are you sure, Pallad?

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I'm very sure, Mr. Cyrus.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Discussing Joel's dad?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, if it isn't the Traveler! Joel sent you, I'll wager.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: That child has asked someone to come ask us for news practically every day...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This time, though... We've got some good news for him, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Previously, we were organizing some special training on Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: It might be best if I explained the rest, Mr. Cyrus.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: So, while taking part in that training, I wound up straying from the arranged path due to a huge blizzard.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: As I was groping my way back on track, I saw a blurred silhouette on a cliff.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: I thought that this must be a lost adventurer, just like myself, so I yelled for their attention.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, before I could attract that person's attention... My cries attracted some monsters first.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Now I don't know about you, but I wasn't confident that I could take them on in such conditions, so I beat a hasty retreat.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Once I got back, I related the matter to Mr. Cyrus.

choices.text: So the person you saw was Joel's father?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Regardless, at least now we know that *someone* is trapped on Dragonspine. As such, I believe a rescue is in order.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Whether that person is Joel's father Joserf or not... Now that is up to fortune.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Either way, I've already dispatched all with the capability to explore Dragonspine to fan out and search.

response.speaker: Reckless Pallad
response.text: Really? That's amazing! Let's head out together, then.

choices.text: I'll go beat those monsters up.
That could have been any old lost adventurer, you know...

talks.objective: Go to Dragonspine and look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, you've returned!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Has he now? Hah! I knew he always had a responsible bone in him somewhere...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Once I've finished the matters I have on hand, I'll go to Dragonspine to check on that boy Joel myself and give him the news.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: So if you would, please tell him that I'll be right with him shortly.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: It will take a moment for me to finish my work. Don't keep the lad waiting, now!

choices.text: Will we really find that person?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: ...Well, there's no guarantee, of course. I can only say that we'll do all we can.

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Hey there! What's the latest news?

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Oh... So Uncle Cyrus hasn't found my dad yet, right?

choices.text: Have a little faith in him.

response.speaker: Joel
response.text: I know... I'll ask Uncle Cyrus for more details when he gets here, then. Thanks a bunch!

choices.text: They've got some clues, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Well, at least this area's safe now. Thanks a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Joserf...

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I didn't find anything earlier, either.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: However, since the coast is clear, I'll continue my search now.

dialogues.speaker: Reckless Pallad
dialogues.text: Would you mind helping me make a trip back to inform Mr. Cyrus that I've begun search efforts? Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Joel
dialogues.text: Please help me look for Uncle Cyrus and ask him...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: There's little time to lose...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: So if you would, please tell him that I'll be right with him shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It will take a moment for me to finish my work. Don't keep the lad waiting, now!
